title: Research Index Entry
description: One item in the Research Farm index. Describes a single research topic (seed), its current lifecycle status, and paths to the immutable proof burrow, report, and critic notes.

slug.description: Stable, URL-safe identifier. Lowercase letters, digits, dashes. Must match the basename (without .md) of topic_path.

title.description: Human-readable title shown in the Habitat quest board.

status.description: Lifecycle status. queued = waiting on the quest board. running = active forage. complete = harvest written. failed = see proof burrow for failure notes. archived = kept for history, hidden from default Habitat view.

priority.description: Quest-board priority. Habitat sorts by this then by created_at.

depth.description: How deep the research is expected to go. Quick = <30 min, standard = ~1 hr, deep = multi-hour with extensive source review.

confidence.description: Self-reported confidence in the harvest (0.0 - 1.0). null until completed.

source_count.description: Number of distinct sources captured in the proof burrow's sources.jsonl.

citation_count.description: Number of citations captured in the proof burrow's citations.json.

created_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD when the seed was filed. null if backfilled from elsewhere.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC when the forage started. null until status is running or later.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC when the harvest was sealed. null until completed.

model_used.description: Model identifier used to author the harvest (e.g., 'gpt-4.1', 'claude-opus-4-7'). null until completed.

runner_version.description: Research runner version (e.g., 'slimy-research-runner@0.2.0'). null until a runner exists in a later phase.

pdf_path.description: Path to the almanac PDF, relative to KB root. MUST be null in Phase 1. When set later, it MUST live under research/.

report_path.description: Path to the harvest report.md, relative to KB root. null until completed. When set, MUST live under research/.

critic_path.description: Path to critic.md, relative to KB root. null until completed. When set, MUST live under research/.

proof_path.description: Path to the proof burrow directory, relative to KB root. null until claimed. When set, MUST live under research/runs/.

topic_path.description: Path to the seed frontmatter file, relative to KB root. Must exist on disk.

tags.description: Lowercase, dash-separated tags. Used by Habitat filters and by the future lore barn.

related_harness_session.description: Identifier of a harness session that produced or inspired this seed. null for now.

related_guild_campaign.description: Identifier of a future guild/MCP campaign this seed is part of. null until an explicit future bridge exists.

assigned_critter.description: Critter, farmhand, or guild-pet handle currently responsible for the forage. null when queued.

immutable_run_id.description: Stable run id (matches the runs/YYYY-MM-DD-slug/ directory name) once the seed has an actual proof burrow. null in Phase 1.
